serverBannerNone: Server {id} ka abhi banner nahi hai.

permitOwn_denied: current stored restriction aapko deny karti hai
permitOwn_notdenied: matching stored restriction aapko deny nahi karti

automodWordPageInvalid: Page1 se5 ke beech integer choose karo.
roleClickReconcileConfirm: Directed uncertain receipt ko observed role state se resolve karne ke liye confirm:true karo.

automationDestinationSaved: Pending schedule destination channel ID {channel} hua. Text,time aur elapsed repeat unchanged;koi message nahi bheja. Future delivery access phir check karegi.
rankDaily: Tumhare retained daily counts,page {page}/9,UTC,newest first. Zero ka matlab retained count nahi,messages nahi bheje iska proof nahi. Counts quality ya verified participation nahi.

ticketQueueHeader: Stored unresolved tickets,page {page}:oldest first. Sirf IDs/state;live channel existence,access ya occupancy ka proof nahi. Koi transcript read/mutation nahi.
ticketQueueEmpty: Is page par unresolved stored tickets nahi hain.
ticketQueuePageInvalid: Page1 se10 ke beech integer choose karo.
